cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AR&S Sharp video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看這支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: In this video, I'm going to show you how we can automate our browsers using computer use.
cues.zh: 這次要示範如何透過 Computer Use 自動操作瀏覽器。

cues.en: There's many different ways of doing this.
cues.zh: 這件事有很多不同的實作方式。

cues.en: We could do it with screenshots and X and Y coordinates, but I'm actually going to use Playwright in this version of how you can do it.
cues.zh: 例如利用截圖與 X、Y 座標，但這個版本會使用 Playwright。

cues.en: So let's get into that.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。

cues.en: So here I have a solution under computer use called BrowserAutomation.Playwright.
cues.zh: Computer Use 底下有一個 BrowserAutomation.Playwright 方案。

cues.en: And in here, I have installed Microsoft Playwright, which is an automation tool for browsers.
cues.zh: 裡面安裝了 Microsoft Playwright，這是用來自動操作瀏覽器的工具。

cues.en: But of course, I don't want to use Playwright in the normal fashion where I code that press this, press this, and press this, and so on.
cues.zh: 不過我不想採用一般 Playwright 的寫法，逐一寫程式指定按這裡、再按那裡。

cues.en: I want to use it as tools so an AI agent can use them.
cues.zh: 而是想把它包裝成工具，讓 AI 代理程式使用。

cues.en: So if we move up our normal console app here, the first thing we are going to do is we're going to initiate Playwright.
cues.zh: 回到一般的主控台應用程式，第一步是初始化 Playwright。

cues.en: And if Playwright is then not installed, you have set up that if it's not there, it will install it for you.
cues.zh: 這裡也有檢查機制，如果 Playwright 尚未安裝，就會自動安裝。

cues.en: But in my case, I already have it installed.
cues.zh: 不過我的環境已經裝好了。

cues.en: And then we're going to launch Playwright into a browser.
cues.zh: 接著透過 Playwright 啟動瀏覽器。

cues.en: We can't see it yet.
cues.zh: 目前還看不到頁面。

cues.en: But when we go and do a new page, a new page will jump up here.
cues.zh: 建立新頁面後，這裡就會出現一個新視窗。

cues.en: So I'm going to try and place this so we can see it once we go through.
cues.zh: 我先調整位置，方便接下來觀察。

cues.en: Right now, the page will not do anything other than just load a sample page I've made.
cues.zh: 目前頁面只會載入我製作的範例網頁。

cues.en: So I made a sample page with two input fields and a little cursor that we can automate and move around in the system.
cues.zh: 這個範例有兩個輸入欄位，以及一個能隨自動操作移動的小游標。

cues.en: So we have a cursor and an input field for a name and an email.
cues.zh: 所以有游標，以及姓名和電子郵件欄位。

cues.en: And then we have a subscribe button.
cues.zh: 另外還有訂閱按鈕。

cues.en: So it will look like, jump over, it will look like this.
cues.zh: 切過去看，畫面就是這樣。

cues.en: So we have this little automated browser, because we want to, it's technically not needed, but we want to be able to see what actually happens
cues.zh: 這裡有一個自動移動的游標；技術上不需要，但我們希望能看到，

cues.en: when the browser is being used by the AI agent.
cues.zh: AI 代理程式操作瀏覽器時，實際發生了什麼。

cues.en: And this is also what you see from Codex and others, that they have a little, this is the AI agent doing things.
cues.zh: Codex 等工具也有類似的顯示，用來標示目前是 AI 正在操作。

cues.en: Behind the scenes, it's actually just taking up time and space to do it.
cues.zh: 其實背後多做這件事，只會額外花費時間與畫面空間。

cues.en: But it's nice to be able to follow along.
cues.zh: 不過方便跟著觀察，還是很不錯。

cues.en: So I want to have some tools.
cues.zh: 接著需要提供一些工具。

cues.en: So I have a browser tools here. And we're going to go into those tools.
cues.zh: 這裡有 BrowserTools，我們打開來看看。

cues.en: You can see I have a few different tools.
cues.zh: 可以看到幾個不同工具。

cues.en: But we're going to make an agent.
cues.zh: 不過先建立代理程式。

cues.en: And that agent is just a normal response client agent.
cues.zh: 這只是一般使用 Responses Client 的代理程式。

cues.en: I'm using GPT-6 Luna.
cues.zh: 我使用 GPT-6 Luna。

cues.en: I don't think you should go too much further down in order of intelligence, because browser controls like this is kind of advanced.
cues.zh: 不建議選擇能力低太多的模型，因為這類瀏覽器控制算是相當進階的工作。

cues.en: But I've given it some instructions here that it should use the browser tools to complete the user's tasks.
cues.zh: 這裡指示它使用瀏覽器工具完成使用者任務。

cues.en: And it should always read the page, find the labels and buttons it needs to press.
cues.zh: 而且必須先讀取頁面，找出需要操作的標籤與按鈕。

cues.en: And after submitting, it should read the page again in order to check the results.
cues.zh: 送出表單後，應該再次讀取頁面確認結果。

cues.en: And then it should only report success after it has checked the page.
cues.zh: 確認過頁面後，才能回報成功。

cues.en: If it ever meets any terms and condition, meaning pop-ups, cookie pop-ups, and so on, it should accept them.
cues.zh: 如果遇到條款或 Cookie 等彈出視窗，就接受它們。

cues.en: And if it hits any captures, it should stop and report that as a blocking part, because AI is not really meant to solve captures.
cues.zh: 如果遇到 CAPTCHA，就停止並回報阻礙，因為 AI 不應該解這類驗證。

cues.en: And they actually have built in that they're not allowed to do it.
cues.zh: 而且模型內部也有不能這樣做的限制。

cues.en: So they often refuse.
cues.zh: 所以通常會拒絕處理。

cues.en: So that's the instruction for the agent.
cues.zh: 以上就是代理程式的指示。

cues.en: And then we give it some tools.
cues.zh: 接著提供工具。

cues.en: So first off, we give it a read tool.
cues.zh: 第一個是讀取工具。

cues.en: And that read tool is simply just take the body of the page and give back an area snapshot.
cues.zh: 這個工具只是取得頁面 body，再回傳 ARIA 快照。

cues.en: Area is this accessibility mode you can have on web pages.
cues.zh: ARIA 是網頁上的無障礙語意資訊。

cues.en: And it gives back a nice little overview.
cues.zh: 它能提供一份清楚精簡的頁面概覽。

cues.en: We can set a breakpoint here for the first time when we see it.
cues.zh: 先在這裡設中斷點，第一次呼叫時看看。

cues.en: By far, and just a disclaimer for this demo, this is not just something you can copy paste.
cues.zh: 也先提醒，這個示範不是直接複製貼上就能涵蓋所有需求。

cues.en: This cannot do everything in the world that a browser can do.
cues.zh: 它做不到瀏覽器中的所有操作。

cues.en: And it needs to be more advanced.
cues.zh: 完整系統還需要更多進階處理。

cues.en: But that's just work of playwright. That is not work of AI.
cues.zh: 不過那是 Playwright 工具實作的工作，不是 AI 本身的問題。

cues.en: So this is just an example of what you can do in real life.
cues.zh: 這裡只是示範實際能採取的做法。

cues.en: If you really want to make a real browser tool, you should go in and do much, much more here in terms of the various tools.
cues.zh: 如果真的要建立完整的瀏覽器工具，必須增加、完善各種工具功能。

cues.en: But with these six tools, you can actually do surprising a lot.
cues.zh: 不過只靠這六個工具，就已經能完成出乎意料多的事情。

cues.en: So that is reading the page.
cues.zh: 以上是讀取頁面。

cues.en: We can also navigate to another page.
cues.zh: 也可以導覽到另一個頁面。

cues.en: So that's just a go to async where we tell it to go to a new page.
cues.zh: 只要呼叫 GotoAsync，要求前往新網址。

cues.en: And again, whenever we go to a new page, it will give back that new page after it has done it.
cues.zh: 每次導覽完成後，也會回傳新頁面的內容。

cues.en: Then we have something to fill out a field.
cues.zh: 接著是填寫欄位的工具。

cues.en: So we ask it to give what label and what value.
cues.zh: 要求模型提供欄位標籤與要填入的值。

cues.en: And again, this is all depending on how is that HTML page built up.
cues.zh: 同樣地，是否容易操作，取決於網頁 HTML 的結構。

cues.en: If it's built for accessibility, then it's easy to link the label and the value.
cues.zh: 如果網頁有做好無障礙設計，就很容易把標籤與欄位對應起來。

cues.en: Else it might need to go in and investigate some more before it can actually do it, just like a codex would.
cues.zh: 否則就得像 Codex 一樣，先進一步檢查頁面，才能操作。

cues.en: Just like a codex would if a web page is not adhering to the various HTML standards.
cues.zh: 例如遇到沒有遵循 HTML 標準的網頁時。

cues.en: So we can set a breakpoint here as well when that happens.
cues.zh: 這裡也可以設中斷點觀察。

cues.en: Then we have a click button, name says it all.
cues.zh: 接著是點擊按鈕，名稱已經說明用途。

cues.en: We get a name of a button and we find it.
cues.zh: 取得按鈕名稱後，找到對應的按鈕。

cues.en: And in this case, it's by role and find a button that have this name.
cues.zh: 這裡透過 Role，尋找具有該名稱的 button。

cues.en: But again, there could be many different ways with Playwright to do all these things.
cues.zh: 不過 Playwright 還有很多其他定位方式。

cues.en: There's all the get by label, get by all text, get by test ID, get by text, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 例如 GetByLabel、GetByAltText、GetByTestId、GetByText 等。

cues.en: And it's also here we can see that we move the cursor to the place.
cues.zh: 這裡也會把游標移到目標位置。

cues.en: We also did that in fields so we can see it moving around.
cues.zh: 填寫欄位時也有同樣處理，讓我們看到游標移動。

cues.en: And finally, we have a press key.
cues.zh: 最後是按鍵工具。

cues.en: So if we need to press something in order to activate something like a search field or anything, we sent a label of the label
cues.zh: 如果要透過按鍵啟動搜尋欄位等功能，就傳入欄位的標籤，

cues.en: that belongs to that field and its key.
cues.zh: 以及要按下的鍵。

cues.en: So in that way, we just say get it by label, press the key, and wait for the page to load again and read it again.
cues.zh: 這樣就能依標籤找到欄位、按鍵，再等待頁面載入並重新讀取。

cues.en: So simple tools and this show cursor is just some JSON, no, not JSON, JavaScript.
cues.zh: 這些工具很簡單；ShowCursor 則只是一段 JavaScript，不是 JSON。

cues.en: I had an AI agent write that for me because I'm not good at JavaScript.
cues.zh: 我不擅長 JavaScript，所以請 AI 代理程式替我寫。

cues.en: But it's essentially just animating that our agent cursor
cues.zh: 基本上就是讓代理程式游標以動畫方式，

cues.en: moves to that position where we just press something with a target.
cues.zh: 移動到剛才操作的目標位置。

cues.en: So that is our six or five different tools that we give.
cues.zh: 這就是提供給模型的五、六種工具。

cues.en: And then we give our task.
cues.zh: 接著提供任務。

cues.en: So our task will be that to fill out a newsletter on the page I showed you, this one, with Ada Lovelace and ada.example.com,
cues.zh: 第一個任務是在剛才的網頁填寫電子報訂閱表單，姓名為 Ada Lovelace，信箱為 ada@example.com，

cues.en: click the subscribe button, and then verify that those values have happened.
cues.zh: 按下訂閱，再確認這些資料確實已送出。

cues.en: And the second task will be then go to Google, go into the search field and search for the word banana, and then verify that the resulting page shows the search result,
cues.zh: 第二個任務是前往 Google，在搜尋欄位搜尋 banana，確認結果頁顯示了搜尋結果，

cues.en: and then report back to us what happened.
cues.zh: 最後回報發生了什麼。

cues.en: So that's our task.
cues.zh: 這就是要做的任務。

cues.en: So that's essentially our input.
cues.zh: 也就是輸入給模型的內容。

cues.en: Again, that could be a chatbot saying, go to this page and do this and this for me.
cues.zh: 也可以改成聊天機器人，由使用者要求前往某個頁面並完成操作。

cues.en: We do an agent.runAsync, just like we normally do.
cues.zh: 接著像平常一樣呼叫 agent.RunAsync。

cues.en: And then we write a little out about usage because usage have a say in these kinds of things.
cues.zh: 最後輸出一點用量資訊，因為這類工作還是得注意 Token 用量。

cues.en: But I will just let it run here and quickly move the page.
cues.zh: 先讓它執行，我快速移動一下頁面。

cues.en: Just let it run here and quickly move the test browser into place so you can see.
cues.zh: 把測試瀏覽器移到適當位置，讓你能看到。

cues.en: So over here, it will tell us what it's doing.
cues.zh: 這裡會顯示它正在做什麼。

cues.en: Oh, I have a breakpoint more. There we go.
cues.zh: 喔，還有一個中斷點。好了。

cues.en: Okay, we have these breakpoints of it doing things.
cues.zh: 目前有幾個工具操作的中斷點。

cues.en: Let's remove them and then we will take them after the fact.
cues.zh: 先移除，稍後再逐步查看。

cues.en: But it's going in, placing the different things, checking that it was right.
cues.zh: 它現在會填入各種資料，再確認結果是否正確。

cues.en: Now it goes into Google, get rid of the cookie, search for banana.
cues.zh: 接著前往 Google、處理 Cookie 視窗，再搜尋 banana。

cues.en: And here we'll also see that some things simply can't be done because Google will actually check,
cues.zh: 這裡也會看到，有些事情就是做不到，因為 Google 會檢查，

cues.en: hey, we don't want AIs doing this.
cues.zh: 並阻止它不希望出現的 AI 自動操作。

cues.en: So it will pop up a capture like this.
cues.zh: 因此會跳出像這樣的 CAPTCHA。

cues.en: Other places will not.
cues.zh: 其他網站可能不會。

cues.en: And that's just the way it is with automated browsers.
cues.zh: 自動化瀏覽器就是會遇到這種情況。

cues.en: It would happen in the same way if we just used to play right by itself.
cues.zh: 即使直接使用 Playwright、不透過 AI，也可能發生。

cues.en: So that's how we do it. Let's set the breakpoints again so we can see the different tools being called and with what they are being called with.
cues.zh: 這就是做法。接著重新設中斷點，看看各工具何時被呼叫，以及傳入了什麼參數。

cues.en: So we have it here. Let's run it again.
cues.zh: 設定好了，再執行一次。

cues.en: The browser is here.
cues.zh: 瀏覽器在這裡。

cues.en: And when we read the page, what we get back is something like this.
cues.zh: 讀取頁面後，取得的內容大致像這樣。

cues.en: So the area snapshot will tell what we have on the page.
cues.zh: ARIA 快照會列出頁面有哪些元素。

cues.en: What we have on the page in this page is very simple.
cues.zh: 這個範例頁面的內容很簡單。

cues.en: Again, it could also just give back the entire HTML, which would be much more difficult for the system to use.
cues.zh: 也可以直接回傳完整 HTML，但那對系統來說比較難處理。

cues.en: But because we have these usability things, it can tell that we have the different fields and what they are called.
cues.zh: 有了無障礙語意資訊，就能知道有哪些欄位，以及它們的名稱。

cues.en: So this is actually what the AI gets back when it gets a page, that this is how the page look like.
cues.zh: 所以 AI 取得頁面時，實際看到的就是這種頁面結構。

cues.en: When we get to Google, it will look much more advanced.
cues.zh: 到了 Google，結構就會複雜得多。

cues.en: So let's jump on further.
cues.zh: 繼續往下。

cues.en: It will now say, hey, I want to put in the value, either lovelace in the field that is linked to the label name.
cues.zh: 現在它要求把 Ada Lovelace 填入標籤為 Name 的欄位。

cues.en: And we get that field back by getting label.
cues.zh: 我們透過 GetByLabel 取得該欄位。

cues.en: And it will do the cursor thing.
cues.zh: 同時會執行游標移動動畫。

cues.en: Can't really do this while having breakpoints.
cues.zh: 有中斷點時，不太方便看動畫。

cues.en: So let's get rid of this so I'm not being run.
cues.zh: 先把這個移除，避免停住。

cues.en: So now, again, we get a new snapshot.
cues.zh: 現在再次取得新的快照。

cues.en: And if we look at the snapshot, it will now tell that the value is either lovelace in that field.
cues.zh: 查看快照，就會發現該欄位的值已經是 Ada Lovelace。

cues.en: Let's keep it so we can see whenever we get to Google.
cues.zh: 先保留後面的中斷點，方便觀察 Google。

cues.en: So now we click a button.
cues.zh: 接著點擊按鈕。

cues.en: It says, click the right button for us.
cues.zh: 它會要求我們點擊正確的按鈕。

cues.en: And it will read the page again.
cues.zh: 然後重新讀取頁面。

cues.en: It will know now that there's a status that it can go in and evaluate.
cues.zh: 現在就知道頁面上有可以檢查的狀態訊息。

cues.en: And then it goes to Google.
cues.zh: 再前往 Google。

cues.en: So we'll send to Google.
cues.zh: 因此這裡導覽到 Google。

cues.en: And there we can read the page, which is much more advanced.
cues.zh: 接著讀取頁面，內容複雜得多。

cues.en: In my case, it's come back in Danish here, but this is what Google looks like in accessibility mode.
cues.zh: 我的環境回傳丹麥文，不過這就是 Google 的無障礙結構。

cues.en: And again, if we don't have accessibility mode, we would end up with just a raw HTML.
cues.zh: 如果沒有這些無障礙資訊，就只能回傳原始 HTML。

cues.en: It could read it, but it is much more token heavy in order to do that.
cues.zh: 模型雖然能讀，但 Token 用量會高很多。

cues.en: So if there is area snapshot, but again, not every page are optimized for blind people and so on.
cues.zh: 因此最好能使用 ARIA 快照；不過並不是所有網站都有為視障使用者等需求做好設計。

cues.en: So sometimes this will not work and you will need some kind of backup that if the area snapshot is actually empty, go in and grab the entire page.
cues.zh: 有時快照沒有內容，就必須準備備援方式，改成取得完整頁面。

cues.en: It will again, click a button and so on and so forth as we go along.
cues.zh: 接下來它會繼續點擊按鈕等操作。

cues.en: We can see what it's doing over here.
cues.zh: 這裡能看到它正在做什麼。

cues.en: And then it will press the enter key on the search field.
cues.zh: 然後在搜尋欄位按 Enter。

cues.en: And it will read the page that it was now.
cues.zh: 再讀取新的頁面，

cues.en: Page that it was now, find a page here.
cues.zh: 也就是目前顯示的這個頁面。

cues.en: That's now this, I'm not a robot page.
cues.zh: 現在是「我不是機器人」驗證頁。

cues.en: And again, had it been another thing or Google haven't been suspicious about this, it would have just shown the search page.
cues.zh: 如果是其他網站，或 Google 沒有懷疑這次操作，就會直接顯示搜尋結果。

cues.en: What we see here as well is it's not too, too expensive.
cues.zh: 另外可以看到，這次費用不算太高。

cues.en: 14,000 input tokens and 281 output tokens.
cues.zh: 大約 14,000 個輸入 Token，以及 281 個輸出 Token。

cues.en: But again, if we would go in here, let's try and say it gets in our HTML instead.
cues.zh: 不過我們也可以把工具改成回傳 HTML，

cues.en: See if it can do the same.
cues.zh: 看看是否一樣能完成。

cues.en: I will believe it can, but it will not be as effective.
cues.zh: 我相信做得到，只是效率不會那麼好。

cues.en: So if we set a snapshot here.
cues.zh: 先在這裡設定中斷點。

cues.en: So the snapshot now would be the entire div and everything.
cues.zh: 現在快照會變成完整 div 與所有內容。

cues.en: And it will need to begin to find where the labels are and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 模型必須自行找出標籤與欄位的位置。

cues.en: But I will believe it would be capable of doing it still.
cues.zh: 不過我相信它仍有能力處理。

cues.en: Let me get rid of this.
cues.zh: 先把這個移除。

cues.en: Let me set a breakpoint so we can see Google.
cues.zh: 再設個中斷點，看看 Google，

cues.en: It's version because now we get minified things and everything.
cues.zh: 回傳的內容，因為現在會包含壓縮後的程式碼等資訊。

cues.en: In this case, it's actually probably not even enough for it to know what's going on.
cues.zh: 在這裡，甚至可能還不足以讓它理解發生了什麼。

cues.en: So we need to, oh, yeah, we'll see if it's capable.
cues.zh: 所以我們看看它是否處理得了。

cues.en: And now we got the real page and this is minified.
cues.zh: 現在取得完整頁面，而且內容是壓縮過的。

cues.en: So it's difficult for us to read.
cues.zh: 對我們而言很難閱讀，

cues.en: Luckily for an AI, it's pretty easy to read.
cues.zh: 幸好 AI 還是比較容易讀懂。

cues.en: So we can still do it. Get rid of this.
cues.zh: 所以仍然能繼續，先移除中斷點。

cues.en: And see that we end up with capture, but you can now see we use 845,000 input tokens.
cues.zh: 最後一樣遇到 CAPTCHA，但現在可以看到，輸入 Token 已經用了 845,000。

cues.en: Luckily, I'm on a Luna, so it's not too, too expensive.
cues.zh: 幸好使用的是 Luna，費用還不算太高。

cues.en: But if you can go by the simpler area snapshots made for usability,
cues.zh: 但如果可以使用為無障礙用途設計、比較精簡的 ARIA 快照，

cues.en: then definitely go do that.
cues.zh: 就一定要優先使用。

cues.en: Else it will begin to be quite, quite expensive to do this.
cues.zh: 否則這類操作很快就會變得相當昂貴。

cues.en: And again, this will not work on everything.
cues.zh: 而且再次提醒，這個範例不適用所有網站。

cues.en: This will only work on the big sites and on sites that have actually implemented ARIA.
cues.zh: 它主要適用大型網站，以及確實實作 ARIA 的網站。

cues.en: It's called. Cool.
cues.zh: 這個標準就叫做 ARIA。

cues.en: But as you can see, it's kind of simple to actually do.
cues.zh: 不過如你所見，基本實作其實很簡單。

cues.en: The hard thing will actually just be to make the right tools for the job.
cues.zh: 真正困難的是替工作準備正確的工具。

cues.en: The rest of it is just normal AI work as we go along.
cues.zh: 其餘就只是一般的 AI 呼叫流程。

cues.en: So if you need a browser tool like that, you can do it.
cues.zh: 所以如果需要這樣的瀏覽器工具，你確實可以自己做。

cues.en: Again, it is a bit heavy if you do it like this, and there will be tons of different scenarios
cues.zh: 不過這樣寫仍有一定負擔，實際上會遇到大量不同情境，

cues.en: and tons of certain pages that need more tools that need better versions of these tools.
cues.zh: 還有許多特殊頁面，需要更多工具或更完善的工具版本。

cues.en: Another thing which is good with Playwright is that you can actually set them headless.
cues.zh: Playwright 還有一個優點，就是可以使用 Headless 模式。

cues.en: So if we run it like this, it will run in a browser, but that browser is not shown anymore.
cues.zh: 這樣執行時，仍然會使用瀏覽器，但不會顯示瀏覽器視窗。

cues.en: I don't have it in my taskbar, but it can still sit and do all this behind the scenes, just automating in the background.
cues.zh: 工作列上也看不到，但它仍能在背景完成所有自動操作。

cues.en: So we can't really see that it's doing what it's doing, but we can follow along in the buttons and fields it's pressing and things.
cues.zh: 雖然不能直接看見畫面，仍然可以從按鈕、欄位等操作記錄追蹤進度。

cues.en: So it's doing exactly the same. It can read it.
cues.zh: 它會完成完全相同的工作，也能讀取頁面。

cues.en: We just don't see it at all.
cues.zh: 只是我們完全看不到瀏覽器視窗。

cues.en: So that is everything there is to browser use.
cues.zh: 以上就是 Browser Use 的介紹。

cues.en: Again, there's other ways of doing it.
cues.zh: 同樣地，也有其他做法。

cues.en: I find this the most easy way, but I also need to say that I'm probably not going to do this by hand.
cues.zh: 我覺得這是比較簡單的方式，但也得說，我自己大概不會從頭手寫完整系統。

cues.en: There is a reason why OpenAI probably have full-time employees building their browser use.
cues.zh: OpenAI 會聘請全職工程師開發 Browser Use，是有原因的。

cues.en: That's because it's not an easy thing to do.
cues.zh: 因為完整做好並不容易。

cues.en: So if I were to use browser use, I would probably hook up agent framework to the Codex harness instead.
cues.zh: 所以如果我需要 Browser Use，可能會把 Agent Framework 接到 Codex Harness，

cues.en: I had a previous video on that and let it do it on my behalf because it's just a better implementation of a browser.
cues.zh: 先前影片有介紹過，讓它代為處理，因為它的瀏覽器實作更完善。

cues.en: But if you need it and you need it for light work, you can definitely do it with this sample.
cues.zh: 不過如果需求比較輕量，這個範例就已經很實用。

cues.en: So with that, thank you. See you on the next one.
cues.zh: 謝謝收看，我們下支影片見。
